description: This file defines the ClusterManifestProvider class, which implements providers for cluster manifests within the Orleans runtime. It manages the current cluster state, listens for membership updates, retrieves silo manifests asynchronously, and updates its internal manifest accordingly. It also implements lifecycle management and disposes resources properly.
external_methods: void Subscribe(string, ServiceLifecycleStage, Func<CancellationToken, Task>, Func<CancellationToken, Task>)

classes.name: ClusterManifestProvider
classes.description: A provider class responsible for managing and updating the cluster manifest based on membership changes within the Orleans runtime.

methods.name: ProcessMembershipUpdates
methods.description: Asynchronously processes membership updates from the cluster membership service.

methods.name: UpdateManifest
methods.description: Attempts to update the cluster manifest based on the current cluster membership snapshot.

methods.name: StartAsync
methods.description: Begins the processing task for membership updates.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes dependencies, such as the internal grain factory.

methods.name: StopAsync
methods.description: Stops the membership processing task and cancels ongoing operations.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes lifecycle events for initialization, startup, and shutdown.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disposes resources associated with the provider.

methods.name: LogWarningErrorRetrievingSiloManifest
methods.description: Logs a warning when an error occurs during silo manifest retrieval.

methods.name: LogDebugStartingToProcessMembershipUpdates
methods.description: Logs that membership update processing is starting.

methods.name: LogDebugStoppedProcessingMembershipUpdates
methods.description: Logs that membership update processing has stopped.
